comments.author: Amit Kulkarni
comments.html:
One thing Sun can do is to request manufacturers to radically reduce the x, y, z co-ordinates of the flash drives currently being fitted into the hard drive slots... Bitmicro sells SSD/Flash in multiple connector technologies like SCSI, SATA, IDE etc
SunFire servers can have separate dedicated slots which are about 10-25% of the space given for traditional hot swap drives.
